extraction.notes: No summer 2027 dates or registration milestones were found. The homepage and application page publish July 6–31, 2026; the parents page still displays 2025 dates. The contact page returned no readable text. Searches did not locate a published campus street address; the website's PO Box is a mailing address, not a drop-off location. Optional Friday sleepovers are part of the day camp, not a separately advertised overnight program.

cards.name: Bound for Glory Camp
cards.description: Campers receive individualized literacy tutoring, writing instruction and guided oral reading, alongside outdoor games, enrichment activities and Christian devotions. The four-week day camp includes optional Friday sleepovers and Saturday adventure excursions.

hours.text: Monday–Friday, 8:30–5:30. The daily schedule lists arrival from 7:45–8:30 and parent pickup from 5:30–5:45.

financial_aid.text: We provide our four-week camp at zero costs to our campers’ families.

lunch.text: Bound for Glory Camp will provide two nutritious meals (breakfast and lunch) and a healthy afternoon snack.

cards.review_notes: Obtain the campus street address from the provider. The homepage says overnight excursions occur each Friday, while the A Day At Camp page specifies the first three Fridays, with Saturday pickup at 3:00pm. Daily hours are 8:30–5:30 on the homepage; the daily schedule additionally permits arrival at 7:45 and pickup through 5:45. Eligibility requires Transylvania County residency, age 9–12 at camp onset, eligibility for NC free or reduced-price lunch, and reading or writing scores at least one year below grade level. Application does not guarantee acceptance.
